body.name: rhoZero
body.def: For each rival component \(P_{v,b}^0=\{g:A_{v,b}^0g\le b_{v,b}^0\}\), choose the first row \(i\) with rational gap \(\gamma_{v,b,i}=(A_{v,b}^0u_*-b_{v,b}^0)_i>0\). Compute by rational bisection an upper bound \(s_{v,b,i}\ge\|(A_{v,b}^0)_{i\cdot}\|_{\Sigma_0}\), and set \(\rho_{v,b}=\gamma_{v,b,i}/s_{v,b,i}\). If no violated row exists, set \(\rho_{v,b}=0\). Define \(\rho_0=\min(\{1\}\cup\{\rho_{v,b}:v\ne v_*, (v,b)\in\mathcal I_0\})\).
body.role: finite total row-separation certificate whose positivity is a theorem
